# Formalization status

The published D4 result in this folder is the non-Lean computer-assisted proof:
the written arguments in `paper.tex`, the exact data in `data/`, and the
replay programs in `verify/`.

The Lean formalization is unreleased work and is not included in this package.
It has no supported build command here, and no Lean compilation or axiom report
is required for the published result. Historical notes or recorded receipts
that mention that work are provenance only and are not reproducible inputs to
the non-Lean verifier.
